title: Double Insight Recalls Multicookers Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: A manufacturer defect can cause the multicooker to overheat and melt on the underside, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 104,000.

title: Goodman Company Recalls Packaged Terminal Air Conditioners and Heat Pumps Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The outdoor fan motors can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 534,000 in the U.S. (In addition, about 3,400 in Canada).

title: Graco Recalls Highchairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The highchair's rear legs can pivot out of position making the chair unstable and posing a fall hazard to a child in the highchair. Units: About 36,000 (In addition, 3,200 were sold in Canada).

title: Beanworthy Recalls Combination Battery Chargers/Hand Warmers Due to Fire and Burn Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The chargers can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,700.

title: eheat Recalls Envi Wall Heaters Due to Overheating and Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Improper wire crimping by the manufacturer can cause the unit to overheat, smoke, or melt, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 35,000 (in addition, about 700 were sold in Canada).

title: Handi-Craft Recalls Dr. Brown's Lovey Pacifier & Teether Holders Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snap can detach from the pacifier's ribbon, posing a choking hazard for young children. Units: About 590,000 (in addition, about 10,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Louis Garneau Recalls Bicycle Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of the federal safety standard for bicycle helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 650 in the U.S. (In addition, about 550 were sold in Canada.).

title: Southwire Recalls Wi-Fi Switches Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The wi-fi switches can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 24,000 (In addition, about 6000 were sold in Canada).

title: Cameron Company Recalls Children's Tents Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The fiberglass rod that supports the tent can break, splinter and become sharp, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 84,000.

title: Radio Flyer Recalls Electric Wagons Due to Injury Hazard
summary: Improper wiring can activate the wagon's motor unintentionally, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: Amazon Recalls Portable Power Banks Due to Fire and Chemical Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The power bank's battery can overheat and ignite, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 260,000.

title: Helvetia Sports Recalls SwissStop Bicycle Disc Brake Pads Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The brake pads can separate from the backplate, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 750.

title: MAAX Spas Recalls Hot Tubs and Swim Spas Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The UV generator inside the hot tub and swim spa can ignite while in use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 550 in the U.S. (In addition, about 630 were sold in Canada).

title: Golden State Warriors Menorahs Recalled by BDA Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The glue that holds the menorah's candleholders can melt causing the candleholders and the lit candles to fall off, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 1,800.

title: First Aid Research Recalls Maximum Strength Bacitraycin Plus Ointment With Lidocaine Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain relieving ointment contains lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put it on their skin or ingest it. Units: About 500,000.

title: Husqvarna Motorcycles Recalls Closed Course Competition Motorcycles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The front brake master cylinder piston can crack, resulting in brake failure, posing a crash hazard to the rider. Units: About 160.

title: Topson Downs Recalls Cat & Jack Girls' Star Studded Jeans Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The metal stars can detach, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 30,000.

title: InSinkErator® Recalls SinkTop™ Switch Accessory for Garbage Disposals Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Water can get into the power module, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,400,000 (In addition, about 28 were sold in Canada).

title: Woodstream Recalls Mosquito Magnet Traps Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled mosquito traps can become damaged if cleaning it while powered on with the company's Quick Clear Cartridge kits and can propel broken pieces of the regulator, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 28,000 in U.S..

title: Goodman Manufacturing Recalls Modular Blowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The labels found on the serial plate have incorrect electrical information that could result in installers and servicers using undersized wiring or incorrect fuse/circuit breaker parts, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,650 in the U.S. (In addition, about 80 were sold in Canada).

title: H-E-B Recalls Halogen Lightbulbs Due to Laceration and Fire Hazards
summary: The halogen light bulbs can shatter while in use in a lamp or light fixture, posing laceration and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 2.5 million.

title: Octane Fitness Recalls Cross Trainers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The incline lead screw can shear off, causing the foot pedals to drop unexpectedly, resulting in a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 570.

title: Primo Recalls Beverage Dispensers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Hot water can drip from the machine when it is used in high altitude areas over 6,000 feet in elevation, posing a burn hazard to users. Units: About 11,000.

title: Residential Elevators Recalls to Inspect Elevators Due to Impact Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The elevator cab can rise unexpectedly to the top of the elevator shaft and abruptly stop, posing an impact hazard to consumers in the elevator cab. Units: About 3,700.

title: Shop LC Recalls Electric Blankets Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The blankets' heating coils can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 1650.

title: SpeeCo® and Woods® Recall 4-Way Wedge Accessory for Log Splitters Due to Impact Injury Hazard
summary: The 4-way wedge accessory can loosen or detach from the log splitter during operation and strike an operator or bystander Units: About 5,100, (In addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: Kidde Recalls Dual Sensor Smoke Alarms Due to Risk of Failure to Alert Consumers to a Fire
summary: A yellow cap left on during the manufacturing process can cover one of the two smoke sensors and compromise the smoke alarm's ability to detect smoke, posing a risk of consumers not being alerted to a fire in their home. Units: About 452,000 in the U.S. (In addition, about 40,000 were sold in Canada

title: Briggs & Stratton Recalls Riding Mowers Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The reverse-mow option switch can malfunction and allow the riding lawn mowers to unintentionally mow when being driven in a reverse direction, posing a risk of injury to bystanders. Units: About 18,000 (In addition, about 300 were sold in Canada).

title: Carrier® Recalls to Repair Commercial Rooftop HVAC Units Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The HVAC's humidimizer fan can fail to shut off when a connected smoke detector is tripped, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 530.
